stage: normative criteria frozen before implementation completion and final review

required_sources.task_evidence: Current relevant implementation and latest related product/QA records sufficient to trace answer, recording, transcript, feedback and context lifecycles; exact paths are located independently after seal, not invented here.
required_sources.notes: Full current AGENTS includes original nonempty lines171/173. Inspect direct task-closeout filenames for newer uncovered records. Two examples remain unapplied examples. Two proposals are protected, not counted as method bodies.

count_policy: All historical 32 sources remain mandatory for product scope, plus previous case README and final validation receipt; new workflow source(s) add rather than replace. Role additions are explicitly selected from existing materials; unknown ownership and missing original memory stay distinct.
acceptance: Entry AGENTS marker + onboarding README + routing clearly distinguish mandatory common inputs and role supplement; whole-list flow, not selective role/method menu, is normal startup.

From ordinary repository entry, a single discovered read flow crosses every mandatory source and all pages in deterministic order; every nonfinal page has the one explicit next command, including cross-source transition; final response is not all-received proof.

Freeze exact required-source list, selected roles, method fixed revision and current dirty/untracked source bytes; reject continuation if changed, role-set differs, cursor malformed/nonobject/forged sequence, or source/version changed. No application, employee or historical edits.

Payload remains bounded for UTF8, escaped controls, long lines and all metadata. No omitted/duplicate/gap bytes, no whole-corpus output that may be cut. Full mechanisms only reassemble privately in memory, save hashes/ranges.

Flow session/cursor if used is untrusted continuation bookkeeping, not authenticated delivery, understanding, actual application, independent QA or natural-loading success. A caller that constructs a later cursor must not receive an authenticated-consumption claim.

Access denied, missing local root, wrong method version/origin, dirty method blob or symlink must block without fallback/search/network; catalog whitelist, traversal, arbitrary credential, cross-role and stale-page bindings rejected.
Existing read_source per-source/list and check_startup interfaces remain compatible; checker0, file/hash or methods alone never earns complete coverage.

All original FAIL/partial and first submissions retained byte-for-byte; latest 26-file case remains original. at least latest README/validation receipt in current required record set; no historical conclusion upgraded.

No private full bodies/reconstructable page cache/raw logs/hidden analysis saved to repository/audit/temp. No proposals read as adopted policy, formal adoption, event hook or Git/network/config action.

Independent actual-source in-memory reconstruction of AGENTS plus all required source bodies exact and bounded verifies mechanics only; later fresh business uses no source/path hints and separate QA evaluates visible delivery, readback/application and artifact.
planned_counterexamples: missing transition or source skipped at final page
last page requested without actual earlier delivery; untrusted cursor disclosure
cursor invalid JSON/nonobject/modified/out of range/role mismatch
source changed after plan/within read or project HEAD drift
method revision/origin/worktree mismatch or inaccessible locator
long single line/CRLF/nonterminal newline/control escaping/Unicode page boundary
selected role absent and fallback role lacks original memory
older catalogue omits latest record or old32
all metadata succeeds while body not visibly delivered
decision_policy: Any blocking defect produces needs_revision with retained original receipt. Original author fixes; exact counterexample and related scope rerun, version bound. No new business dispatch until mechanism verdict accepted by root. No claim that mechanism pass proves fresh natural reading.
